text: {"sql": "WITH late_aborted AS ( SELECT agv_id, COUNT(*) AS late_aborted_tasks FROM sf_fleet.agv_tasks WHERE status IN ('late','aborted') AND start_ts >= '2026-07-01' AND start_ts < '2026-11-01' GROUP BY agv_id ) SELECT a.agv_id, a.faults_90d, COALESCE(l.late_aborted_tasks, 0) AS late_aborted_tasks, (a.faults_90d + COALESCE(l.late_aborted_tasks, 0)) AS reliability_total FROM sf_fleet.agvs a LEFT JOIN late_aborted l ON l.agv_id = a.agv_id ORDER BY reliability_total DESC, a.faults_90d DESC, late_aborted_tasks DESC LIMIT 1", "columns": ["agv_id", "faults_90d", "late_aborted_tasks", "reliability_total"], "purpose": "Rank AGVs by combined 90-day faults and Jul-Oct 2026 late/aborted task counts, returning the single least reliable AGV with its totals."}

data.sql: WITH late_aborted AS ( SELECT agv_id, COUNT(*) AS late_aborted_tasks FROM sf_fleet.agv_tasks WHERE status IN ('late','aborted') AND start_ts >= '2026-07-01' AND start_ts < '2026-11-01' GROUP BY agv_id ) SELECT a.agv_id, a.faults_90d, COALESCE(l.late_aborted_tasks, 0) AS late_aborted_tasks, (a.faults_90d + COALESCE(l.late_aborted_tasks, 0)) AS reliability_total FROM sf_fleet.agvs a LEFT JOIN late_aborted l ON l.agv_id = a.agv_id ORDER BY reliability_total DESC, a.faults_90d DESC, late_aborted_tasks DESC LIMIT 1
data.purpose: Rank AGVs by combined 90-day faults and Jul-Oct 2026 late/aborted task counts, returning the single least reliable AGV with its totals.
